citations.title: Build the web for agents, not agents for the web
citations.authors: see arXiv record; author list not verified in this dispatch
citations.method_rule: Do not assume the human-facing rendering is the agent-facing interface. Target the page's semantic structure directly rather than reproducing what a human reader sees.

citations.title: Beyond Pixels: Exploring DOM Downsampling for LLM-Based Web Agents
citations.authors: see arXiv record; author list not verified in this dispatch
citations.method_rule: Raw DOM is impractical at realistic page sizes, where deeply nested containers, styling hooks and decorative elements obscure semantic structure. Downsample to the semantic skeleton before extraction rather than parsing raw HTML.
citations.objective: extraction fidelity: keep the semantic structure legible

citations.title: WebVoyager: Building an End-to-End Web Agent with Large Multimodal Models
citations.authors: see arXiv record; author list not verified in this dispatch
citations.method_rule: Screenshots omit content that is occluded, unrendered or hidden behind interaction. Do not treat visual salience as a proxy for presence; confirm against a structural representation.

citations.title: Revisiting Observation Reduction for Web Agents: Comprehensive Evaluation with a Lightweight Framework
citations.authors: Masafumi Enomoto, Ryoma Obara, Haochen Zhang, Masafumi Oyamada
citations.method_rule: Downsample HTML observations using extractive methods with domain-specific optimization to reduce agent latency while maintaining performance.
citations.objective: cost: bound observation size and latency

citations.title: Entity Resolution in Practice: Lessons from a Self-Serve Pipeline
citations.authors: see arXiv record; author list not verified in this dispatch
citations.method_rule: Do not take transitive closure over pairwise matches. One false positive chains records that share nothing into a single cluster, and the error compounds rather than averaging out. Require a verified merge step before joining clusters.

citations.title: Generalized Bayesian Record Linkage and Regression with Exact Error Propagation
citations.authors: see arXiv record; author list not verified in this dispatch
citations.method_rule: Carry linkage uncertainty into the downstream conclusion rather than collapsing matches to boolean edges. A graph built from hard edges reports a confidence it never earned.

citations.title: A Survey of Blocking and Filtering Techniques for Entity Resolution
citations.authors: see arXiv record; author list not verified in this dispatch
citations.method_rule: Block candidates on a cheap key before pairwise comparison, so comparison cost stays tractable and unrelated records are never compared in the first place.

citations.title: Directive queued to the shared inbox, unread for 28 minutes while status flowed outward
citations.method_rule: Read the inbound channel before doing anything else on a tick. A coordination agent that writes status outward while never reading inbound has wired half a channel and will report itself healthy while directives sit unread.

citations.title: Acknowledge on receipt, then answer, so the sender knows the message landed before the work is done
citations.method_rule: Acknowledge an inbound message the moment it is seen, before processing it. Silence between arrival and completed work is indistinguishable from not having received it.

citations.title: A receipt appeared while the directive it acknowledged remained unapplied
citations.method_rule: A delivery receipt is not application. Track directives to the observable effect they were supposed to cause, and treat acknowledged-but-not-applied as still open.

citations.title: Idle threshold tripped and escalation was deliberately withheld because the content would have been identical
citations.method_rule: Escalate on new information, not on a timer alone. Re-sending identical content because a threshold elapsed again is noise, and it trains the recipient to ignore the channel. Send a duration update instead of a repeat.

citations.title: A liveness signal was unavailable rather than negative, and was not treated as evidence of death
citations.method_rule: Distinguish a signal that is absent from a signal that is negative. An unavailable liveness probe is missing evidence, not evidence of failure, and must not be reported as one.

citations.title: A scanner alert was checked against the filesystem before being relayed, and proved to be its own false positive
citations.method_rule: Verify a claim against the underlying artefact before relaying it. A case-insensitive pattern matched a lowercase commit hash and would have been reported as a boundary violation had it been passed on unchecked.

citations.title: An earlier conclusion was publicly corrected when its evidence turned out to be weaker than presented
citations.method_rule: Never confirm what cannot be evidenced, and state the strength of the evidence alongside the claim. Where a conclusion survives but its basis was overstated, correct the basis rather than leaving the conclusion propped on it.

citations.title: Holding a merged defect after flagging it once was recorded as the wrong call
citations.method_rule: Flagging once and then holding is not escalation. Escalate a blocked decision with a stated default at 15 minutes, and apply the default at 30 unless the action is irreversible or external-facing, which waits indefinitely.

citations.title: Read More, Think More: Revisiting Observation Reduction for Web Agents
citations.authors: Masafumi Enomoto, Ryoma Obara, Haochen Zhang, Masafumi Oyamada
citations.method_rule: Adaptively select the observation representation from the model's capability and its thinking token budget, rather than fixing one representation for every model and every step.
citations.objective: sufficiency: give the model enough to reason with

citations.title: LineRetriever: Planning-Aware Observation Reduction for Web Agents
citations.authors: Imene Kerboua, Sahar Omidi Shayegan, Megh Thakkar, Xing Han Lu, Massimo Caccia, Veronique Eglin
citations.method_rule: Retrieve only the lines the current plan needs, judged against the planning horizon rather than against the page. Reducing by relevance to the page drops lines the planner still required.
citations.objective: sufficiency: keep what the plan will need next
